fusions.name: Bagged Swarm
fusions.desc: Throws a mesh bag of stinging workers that bursts on the first enemy it meets, dealing 26 damage to it and 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles. Each one hit is [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Honeyed Cords
fusions.desc: A lash of honey-smeared cords that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles. It leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Dripping Comb
fusions.desc: Hangs a lattice of honeycomb where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Tethered Hive
fusions.desc: A bonded swarm travels with you in a mesh skep, stinging enemies within 4 tiles for 2 damage every second. Each sting leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows it by 15% for 2 seconds.
